description:
Seo-Hun, an unknown idol in his third year since debut. When illegal footage of his younger brother, Eloy, a successful idol in contrast to him, is leaked, Seo-Hun assaults another idol who insulted his brother during a live broadcast. Afterward, Eloy takes his own life, and Seo-Hun’s life also spirals into ruin.

*Heart-Pounding Island*, an extreme deserted island survival variety show featuring celebrities like Seo-Hun who have caused controversy and seen their lives plummet into ruin.

 *“The person who ruined Eloy’s life is there.”*

Drawn in by a call from a mysterious figure, Seo-Hun participates in the 10-day show to uncover the truth behind his brother’s death.

(Source: Naver, translated)
